code_assumptions_and_limits: AuthorizationAssumption identifies a synthetic gateway producer role that can carry Command records from named controller producers; no cryptographic authentication is implemented.
Packet source SI timestamps use the configured rational tick period to obtain source ticks before the declared affine mapping. No N*dt or physical latency is inferred.
Only interpreted BOUNDED_SET uncertainty admits nominal grants. Recorded covariance alone has no implemented containment interpretation and is denied.

T13 consumes an exact acknowledged new-session barrier at prior desired_epoch+1. Named current FAULT_CLEARANCE evidence is treated as an explicit synthetic assertion over the initiating fault set; faults detected in this transaction cannot be cleared by same-batch reset.

REAUTHORIZE.transition_id is explicit operation provenance, not an S0 dispatch. Disabled S0 IDs are always rejected; other labels require current named REAUTHORIZATION evidence. Binding arbitrary provenance labels to an external scientific handoff remains an independent review obligation.

Missing/corrupt persistence uses an explicit unarmed boot epoch0 followed by fault closure to epoch1, with endpoint-installed epoch unknown. An intact known session retains its epoch/history. This protocol bootstrap convention must be reviewed; it asserts no real endpoint state.

Configuration continuation_policy_id is retained as data; no non-nominal continuation, recovery, deceleration or stop policy is activated. An unsupported retained state or failed nominal eligibility closes authority.

Guard categories short-circuit session/epoch/state before dependent permission validation; all returned causes are canonically reason-sorted. Exact per-event denial grouping and internal trace identity require the unfilled independent golden-trace review.

Internal transition IDs use parent event ID plus transition ID and causal microsteps; boundary IDs include batch ID/type/tick. SEALED_BATCH operation-ledger entries bind batch IDs to original trace sequences without adding unapproved Trace fields.

Persistence is supplied immutable logical state, not filesystem or power durability. Supplied past endpoint observations are journaled without inferring a presently held control or generating an acknowledgement.
